Original source-matched bytes are referenced with exact URLs and hashes. Images and derivatives remain local; redistribution rights were not established.
The two original VIP stills are guide crops with unknown original capture bounds.
Generated images are controlled text fixtures, not gameplay screenshots. They exercise representative 720p/1080p/1440p geometry only.
Tesseract 5.5 diagnostic success does not establish native Windows OCR, native display capture, live gameplay or performance.
Original stills were deliberately sequenced for ownership/accounting replay; they are not proof of one recorded mission episode.
The historical broad-crop Agency source pixels were not retained. Generated Agency/business controls prove the boundary only.
No YouTube/media/browser/native Windows route, packages, Actions, credential access or external publication was used.
